mcq.q: A. B. C. D. Answer: C. Many-to-Many
Which of the following is NOT a standard multithreading model in operating systems?

answer: A major disadvantage of the many-to-one model is that if one thread makes a blocking system call , all other threads are also blocked because only one kernel thread manages all user threads.

In the many-to-many model, multiple user threads are mapped to a smaller or equal number of kernel threads . This model allows the operating system to schedule kernel threads independently and supports concurrency without blocking all threads when one is waiting.

lq.q: Explain different multithreading models in operating systems. Discuss their advantages and disadvantages with examples.
answer: Multithreading models define how user-level threads are mapped to kernel-level threads . The operating system uses these models to manage thread execution and CPU scheduling.
